question: ______________ is necessary for the Transcription of mRNA.
solution:
The correct answer is __**RNA polymerase.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Transcription is the formation of mRNA from DNA.
 
• It occurs inside the nucleus.
 
• It uses DNA as a template.
 
• **RNA polymerase is necessary for the transcription of mRNA.**
 
• **It consists of five subunits which are alpha, beta, beta prime, and omega and sigma.**
 
• **The Sigma factor is essential as it recognizes the transcription start site.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****DNA polymerase:**

 
• **It is essential for replication.**
 
• It occurs inside the nucleus.
 
• Replication is semiconservative in nature.

**Reverse transcriptase:**

 
• It is present inside the virus.
 
• **It forms cDNA(complementary DNA) from mRNA.**

**Taq polymerase:**

 
• It is isolated from the bacteria *Thermus.*
 
• **It is used in a polymerase chain reaction to amplify the DNA strands.**
